text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第1批 · 01 · 阁楼里的未寄信.
Environment: A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: New England 19th-century attic writing room, spring late morning. Sloped chalky ivory plaster ceiling, exposed pale aged oak rafters, a tall dormer window with soft linen curtain at rear left, antique warm-brown writing desk under the light, a few cream envelopes and folded sheets with no legible writing, dried sprigs in a ceramic jar, two worn books, simple wooden chair slightly pulled back. An old trunk and folded cream quilt to far right, open doorway giving a glimpse of another bright room. Camera from the attic entrance, close foreground soft doorjamb, desk off-center to left, generous open floor center. A small amateur theater curtain rolled neatly against the side wall hints at youthful creativity. Research inspiration: Little Women's intimate attic and flowing domestic spaces; create a new setting with sunwashed cream palette. Emotion: a quiet pause before leaving home.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第1批 · 01 · 阁楼里的未寄信. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
